Thanks for the context. I pulled the grant record for olivia.park@nimbushealth.com (signup_id: sg-78b2). The promo was created and a grant record was inserted, but it hit the anti-fraud gating after the async entitlement webhook returned a 202 + "flagged" status from our rules engine. That sets entitlement.inactive_flag = true which keeps the credit from appearing in the UI and prevents billing usage from drawing down the grant.

Two immediate options:
1) Manually flip inactive_flag to false for that grant_id (quick but requires SE/ops exec). I can do this and then force a cache refresh so the UI shows $500.
2) If we want to respect gating, kick off a light manual review (5–10m) to confirm customer identity and allow an automated unflag.

Given they have a validation tomorrow, I recommend option 1 as a short-term fix. I’ll also add a follow-up to root cause why the rules engine flagged that signup (IP range + email domain heuristics).

If you approve, I’ll flip the flag and post the audit log here.

- Dev

We also attached a short audit note for your records (redacted): grant_id: gr-9f4c, amount: 500, reason: manual-unflag after false-positive.
